items.text: Pay yourself first. Move savings out the moment you get paid.
Track your spending for one month. Awareness changes behavior.
Build a small emergency fund before you invest.
Wait 24 hours before any non-essential purchase.
Small recurring subscriptions add up. Review them every few months.
Spend on skills. They pay you back for years.
Avoid debt with high interest. It grows faster than most savings.
Income matters, but what you keep matters more.
Compound growth rewards time more than timing.
Write a budget that fits your real life, not an ideal one.
Never put money you need soon into risky bets.
Teach yourself one money lesson every week.
